status: selects pass. Not assembled, not approved, picture unchanged.

source.receivedAs: uploaded as FLAC (the brief calls it shoot-the-moon-vo-session-01.wav); FLAC is lossless, so the samples are identical
source.timebase: seconds from the first sample; *Sample fields are sample offsets at 44.1 kHz

method: Offline speech recognition (PocketSphinx en-us; three passes: script-constrained language model, general English model, and per-line grammars with competing wordings), forced alignment for word timings, then measurement per take: level, clipping, low-frequency pops, mouth clicks in pauses, pace, pause structure, pitch range and the direction of the final pitch movement. Delivery judgements are inferred from those measurements and from spectrograms; they are not a substitute for listening to the close calls named in VO_SELECTS.md.
takeNumbering: Take N is the Nth reading of a line in the session, in recording order. No verbal slates were recorded.

allowed: 80 Hz high-pass, 12 dB/octave (the room noise and the one plosive pop sit below it)
per-line clip gain (clipGainDb), so lines sit within about 1.5 LU of each other
10 ms fade-in and 30 ms fade-out at every in/out point; 15 ms equal-power crossfade at each internal cut
a continuous room-tone bed from roomTone, at its recorded level, under the whole narration span, so the gaps between lines do not drop to digital silence
forbidden: de-essing or EQ beyond the high-pass
compression beyond 2:1 with more than 3 dB of gain reduction
any synthetic voice or word repair
